# DevCraft — AI-Driven Web Development Agency

> AI-driven web development, bespoke interfaces, and ISTQB-certified quality assurance — crafted for brands that refuse to blend in.

## About

DevCraft is a web development agency based in Thessaloniki, Greece. We specialize in custom web development using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Our team includes ISTQB-certified QA engineers who guarantee bug-free launches.

We serve clients in Greece and worldwide, with full bilingual support (English & Greek).

## Pricing & Service Plans

We offer four service plans. The MAXI plan is our most popular choice:

### MINI: The Clean Start (€600–€700)
Single responsive landing page. Includes semantic HTML, alt-text, social redirects, and CTA integration. 1 language (Greek). Delivered in 2–3 working days.

### MIDI: The Corporate Standard (€900–€1,000)
Up to 5 pages with lead form, portfolio/gallery, sitemap & robots.txt, GDPR/cookie compliance, and Google Maps. 1 language. Delivered in 4–5 working days.

### MAXI: The International Presence (€1,300–€1,500) ⭐ Most Popular
Multilingual website (2–3 languages) with up to 7 pages, language switcher, localized meta tags, URL optimization, custom 404 pages, GDPR compliance, and Google Maps. Delivered in 7–10 working days.

### ELITE: The Elite Performance (€1,950–€2,500)
Up to 10 pages with unlimited languages, AI assistant integration, custom animations, form-to-email logic, automatic image optimization, SEO-friendly URLs, and ISTQB-certified QA. Delivered in 10–12 working days.

*Prices do not include VAT.
*Delivery starts after all content is received from the client.

Custom Annual Maintenance & Quality Assurance plans are available upon request.
Additional functionalities and custom add-ons can be tailored to your specific needs.

Full pricing details: https://devcraft.gr/prices

## Quality Guarantee

- ISTQB-certified QA engineers test every feature before launch
- Zero-defect launch policy
- Testing across desktop and mobile on Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android

## Technology Stack

React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Supabase, Vite, Framer Motion
